name: Spyglass of The Polar Mariner
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 5th; Slot —; Price 3,500 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Made from exquisite wood with precision crafted glass lenses, astute captains never set sail on the polar seas without this handmade spyglass. Although the spyglass does not increase the owner’s visibility range, the spyglass loudly whistles in the owner’s hand whenever an iceberg of Small size or larger comes within visual range, even if the spyglass’s owner is not actively looking for icebergs or even using the spyglass.

If the owner looks through the spyglass, the whistling grows louder as it points to the largest iceberg within visual range. If more than one iceberg is within range, the spyglass points to the large iceberg first.

Calibrating the spyglass to view each iceberg requires a full-round action.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells locate object; Cost 1,750 gp.
